assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-quality 2D SHMUP game sprite, prerendered 3D spacecraft hull for Nova Swarm.
Camera and framing: STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN dorsal view, ship nose points straight UP, all engines point DOWN. Exactly one complete centered hull. Broad landscape transport silhouette about 2.4 times as wide as tall, with comfortable transparent margin around every extremity. Bilateral mechanical balance, substantial central bridge spine and two large side holding-bay structures.
Gameplay integration: The renderer adds captive fighters and glowing shootable locks separately. Leave one clearly defined empty recessed holding-bay space in the left half and one in the right half of the hull. The spaces belong inside the hull structures; do not paint fighters, prisoners, lock symbols, UI, targets, or unattached props. The bays must be readable at gameplay size.
Rendering: premium detailed textured 3D asset, convincing layered materials, purposeful large armor forms, restrained fine mechanical detail, clear edge separation against dark space, coherent with a gritty sophisticated arcade SHMUP fleet. Soft neutral overhead lighting and dimensional self-shading only. Crisp readable silhouette, no huge emissive effects.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the hull, including empty gaps. No sky, ground, backdrop, cast/drop shadow, pedestal, frame, text, logos, watermark, stars, or perspective tilt. No line art, flat vector icon, schematic, conventional small fighter icon, or distant ship. No oversized bloom or long exhaust trails. This is a large transport hull sprite, not a poster.
Subject: TALON, a black and amber angular armored prison transport. A wide predatory clamp-like silhouette, long sharply swept outer armor prongs, faceted trapezoidal side holding bays, and a compact wedge nose at the top. The wide flanking structures dominate over the short central body. Layered charcoal-black ceramic and gunmetal armor, controlled amber inset lighting and a few amber hazard panels without symbols or writing. Recessed industrial grilles, dense armored bulkheads, clear chamfered edges with pale steel wear. Small engine vents at the lower rear of the central hull and side structures. Make its profile unmistakably angular and armored, not a rectangular cargo barge.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished top-down 2D space-shooter enemy sprite, one isolated spacecraft, genuinely transparent background. LANCER: an exceptionally sharp split-spear interceptor, silver and gunmetal armor with restrained icy-blue insets. Two long parallel forward spear prongs point downward separated by a deep open slot. Broad upper shoulders and two visibly detachable side gun pods with crisp railgun muzzles pointing down. An inset blue reactor sits in the central body. Slender, disciplined, lethal. Premium detailed hand-painted/physically rendered game sprite with strong material definition and crisp edges, matching the polish of a modern arcade shooter. Orthographic camera directly overhead, perfectly flat top view, no perspective tilt. Ship faces DOWN toward the player: nose and firing ends at the bottom, engines at top. Wide bilateral outer silhouette with subtle asymmetric wear and surface greebles. Compact visible central reactor and exactly TWO side weapon pods separated by readable dark mechanical seams; all components attached into one cohesive craft. Entire hull centered and completely visible with 8 percent clear margin. Top-left neutral studio lighting with integrated self-shading only. Preserve readable large armor shapes at small gameplay scale; intricate secondary machining must not obscure silhouette. NO text, logos, letters, symbols, ground plane, cast shadow, background, stars, engines firing, projectile trails, huge baked glow, luminous halo or bloom. Tiny restrained emissive insets only. Square transparent canvas.
assets.repairPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is the Lancer game sprite. Preserve its premium silver/gunmetal armor, icy-blue reactor, split-spear pointed nose facing DOWN, orthographic top view, two detachable side railgun pods, detailed material finish and bilaterally balanced identity. Broaden the shoulder wings and place the existing two side weapon pods farther apart, so the footprint has broad shoulders and a longer central split-spear nose. Preserve two clear downward spear tips and exactly two side railgun pods. No extra ships or objects. Genuine transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no huge glow, no exhaust, no cropped components.
assets.visualInspection: Framing repaired: both engine tops and spear tips visible. Silver-blue split-spear form preserved; visually slimmer than the four other silhouettes.
